newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks close mixed to higher.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks close mixed to higher.

text.p: Croatian stocks closed mixed to higher on Wednesday, with blue chips posting new gains in upbeat trade.
* Of 15 issues nine rose, three fell and three were flat.
* Volume slightly lower at 30,163 units, turnover shrank to 16.9 million kuna.
* Top gainer shipyard Viktor Lenac added 15.10 kuna or 9.7 percent to 171.1 kuna on volume of 6,619 shares.
* Biggest decliner hotelier Zlatni Rat lost 10 kuna or 6.7 percent to 140 with 90 shares sold in a first deal since April.
* Drugs firm Pliva, selling 8,429 shares, was the most active issue. It rose 17.10 kuna to 525.10 kuna.
